quarter panel, a cracked rear bumper cover at the wheel arch, and a dented rear door
skin that runs toward the seam. The pattern of contact is largely consistent with a

of impact. Repair will proceed by blending and refinishing the quarter panel,
replacing the bumper cover, and pulling the door dent before paint. The labor hours
reqeusted fit the scope of this work, and the parts and charges on the invoice show no
